q: Does a Ningxia silicomanganese exporter need to give CBAM data to EU buyers?
title: Ningxia silicomanganese and CBAM
short: No CBAM figure is due. Silicomanganese, declared under CN 7202 30, is not in Annex I; the only ferro-alloys covered are ferro-manganese, ferro-chromium and ferro-nickel. EU steelmakers may still ask for a product footprint, which is a commercial request.
audience: Ferro-alloy producers in Ningxia and Inner Mongolia and their EU customers

ul: Not covered: silicomanganese (7202 30), ferrosilicon (7202 21 and 7202 29) and other 7202 alloys.

p: EU steel mills build product footprints for their own customers and count purchased alloys in Scope 3. A footprint per tonne covering coke, electrodes and electricity answers that request.
If the same furnaces switch to ferro-manganese for EU orders, that product is covered. Keep production and fuel records per campaign so the covered product can be shown on its own.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and production documents into dated, fingerprinted installation records, the starting point for the actual emissions an EU importer asks for.
